mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies at Harriet Park with a temperature of 81 degrees. The overnight low will be 61 degrees, and there is no rain in the forecast. Keep an eye on the sky tonight for a waxing crescent moon and an International Space Station flyover tomorrow morning at 4:47 AM, rising from Belleville toward Fitchburg.

City updates include new volunteer opportunities at the Senior Center which requires a commitment of at least two sessions per month. Additionally, please be aware that road construction on Highway M begins on August 18, which will shift traffic patterns for the next two to three weeks.

We have a packed schedule with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee happening today. Tomorrow, Epic Systems hosts its annual UGM, and Insight Wellness offers yoga classes. Looking ahead to Tuesday, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus or Lake Lou-ee.
Regarding the weekly report, on Wednesday, August 6, an officer observed a vehicle driving erratically and arrested the driver for his fourth O W I offence.
You can cool down today with the Mint Cookie flavor of the day at Culver's. The store is open until 10 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
